subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should Himalaya remain a core-bundled skill that OpenClaw maintains, or should its documentation move to a ClawHub-managed skill as proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132?
rationale: The appropriate fix location and maintenance obligation differ completely depending on whether the open starter-set cleanup removes this optional integration from core.

options.title: Move Himalaya to ClawHub
options.body: Let the starter-set cleanup remove the bundled copy, then maintain corrected, version-current Himalaya guidance as an external skill.

options.title: Retain and refresh in core
options.body: Keep Himalaya bundled and replace the stale examples with a current upstream-audited documentation update.

options.title: Defer pending starter-set PR
options.body: Keep this issue open without another docs PR until the active starter-set proposal is resolved.

recommendation.title: Move Himalaya to ClawHub
recommendation.body: Let the starter-set cleanup remove the bundled copy, then maintain corrected, version-current Himalaya guidance as an external skill.

likelyOwner.reason: Their active member-owned pull request currently carries the concrete decision to remove Himalaya from the bundled starter set.
